meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude guides you through creating and managing Microsoft Entra Agent Identity objects (Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, Agent Identity) via Microsoft Graph, and configuring OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant). Also provides code examples and troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to create an Agent Identity Blueprint or configure agent OAuth token exchange (e.g., fmi_path, OBO). Not for standard Entra app registration or Foundry agent authoring.

Claude will show principal creation and permission grant.
